name: Creature modifiers
description: Persistent creature variants with concrete implications for play

fields.description: This dominant individual coordinates nearby peers, challenges obvious rivals, and protects group cohesion; separating it from allies or provoking its pride can disrupt that control.
This creature is the product of hybridization with {{ creature.generator.name }}. Its physical appearance and abilities are affected as a result.

Reanimation frees it from breathing, sleep, and ordinary nourishment, and many biological hazards lose their relevance; a binding rite, consecrated force, or destruction of its anchor can exploit its unnatural state.
Dense plating, grafts, or magical reinforcement make ordinary glancing attacks less effective, but exposed joints, sensory organs, or an unprotected underside remain exploitable.
Extraordinary size grants imposing reach, force, and control of open ground, but makes concealment difficult and movement through narrow or fragile spaces hazardous.
Permanent fury drives it to close distance and keep attacking despite danger; it is unusually aggressive but easier to lure, distract, or outmaneuver with an obvious target.
This immature specimen is smaller, less resilient, and inexperienced, yet quicker to flee, squeeze through gaps, or react unpredictably when cornered.
Its unusually small body can hide easily and pass through tiny openings, but offers little reach, leverage, or ability to resist being moved.
Its unstable body can seep through solid matter, but it must become tangible to strike, carry objects, or hold ground, creating moments when ordinary attacks can affect it.
It cannot normally be seen, making visual tracking and aimed attacks unreliable; scent, sound, displaced debris, and contact with the surroundings can still reveal its position.
The subject manifest a RULE {{ rules.name }} which changes its appearance and abilities.

Whatever its species would normally suggest, this individual has the anatomy, coordination, and training to wield and effectively use the following weapon: {{ weapons.name }} The GM determines its concrete consequences in play.

The following armor has been fitted, reshaped, or built around this creature so it can wear and meaningfully benefit from its protection: {{ armors.name }} The GM determines its concrete consequences in play.
The creature suffers from the following persistent affliction: {{ affliction }} The GM determines when and how the condition has concrete consequences in play.
This individual possesses the following unusual capability in addition to what is normally expected from its species: {{ traits }} The GM determines how this extra capability matters in play.
Damaged flesh persistently knits itself back together unless interrupted or prevented by {{ weakness.name }}.
Persistent inner heat sheds smoke and embers, threatens flammable surroundings, and makes close contact dangerous; water, deep cold, or suffocation can suppress this advantage.
Supernatural cold coats its body and chills nearby surfaces, hindering close pursuit and bare-handed contact; sustained heat melts the frost and exposes the creature beneath.
Its outline merges with dim surroundings, improving concealment and ambushes in darkness, while strong direct light reveals a sharply defined and vulnerable silhouette.
Great age brings patience, experience, and unusual resistance to familiar hazards, but declining speed and ingrained habits make its responses deliberate and predictable.
A brittle frame cannot withstand sustained force or heavy impacts, so the creature relies on distance, cover, caution, or more robust allies to remain effective.
A permanently damaged limb, wing, or locomotor structure severely limits one form of movement and forces the creature to defend or hunt in a compensating way.
An old wound never healed correctly; noticing and reaching the scar can bypass the creature’s usual protection or provoke pain that changes its behavior.
